$description: DHCW Single Record Design System — Semantic colour tokens (Tier 2). Light mode. All values reference primitive tokens. Prefix: sr (Single Record). Dark mode overrides are in color.dark.json. Source of truth: the Single Record Figma variable collection — keep in sync.

primary.$description: Brand primary. White text on blue-800 = 7.1:1 (AAA).

secondary.$description: Muted dark for secondary interactive elements.

destructive.$description: Destructive UI action (delete, remove). Pair with confirmation.

section-cards.$description: Primary background for card sections in modular layout.

subtle.$description: Subtle section background — table rows, inactive tabs.

inverse.$description: Text on dark or saturated surfaces.

focus.$description: Focus ring — Cyan/800 in both modes (DDR-025, amending DDR-006). Cyan/700 was 2.95:1 on a card and 2.71:1 on the page, under the 3:1 SC 1.4.11 requires. Cyan/800 is the only stop clearing 3:1 in both modes: darker stops fix light mode and fail dark, where surfaces are navy.

accent.$description: Decorative accent only. Borders, icon strokes, chart accents, tab indicators. Never use as a filled surface with text on top.

critical.$description: Red/700 (#B32014) — raised from Red/600 for AA contrast on light status surfaces and text.

critical-surface.$description: Red/50 (#FEF3F2) — lightened from Red/100 so Status/Critical text on it reaches 6.16:1 (was 5.19:1).

success.$description: Green/700 (#006630) — raised from Green/600 for AA contrast on light status surfaces and text.

success-surface.$description: Green/50 (#F0FAF4) — lightened from Green/100 so Status/Success text on it reaches 6.69:1 (was 5.92:1).

warning-surface.$description: Yellow/50 (#FFFAEB) — lightened from Yellow/100 to match the other status surfaces. Note that Status/Warning (Yellow/500) on it is 1.49:1 and must never carry text unaided; see the warning-role exception in the Icons guidance.

info-surface.$description: Info Blue/50 (#EEF5FC) — lightened from Info Blue/100 so Status/Info text on it reaches 6.31:1 (was 5.52:1).
